description: This file defines the TaxClass model class for the Opencart admin module, including methods for creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving tax class records and related tax rules from the database.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Model class for managing tax classes and rules within the OpenCart admin module, extending base Model class.

methods.name: addTaxClass
methods.description: Creates a new tax class record in the database, optionally including associated tax rules, and clears the relevant cache.

methods.name: editTaxClass
methods.description: Updates an existing tax class record in the database, replaces its tax rules, and clears the cache.

methods.name: deleteTaxClass
methods.description: Deletes a tax class and its associated tax rules from the database, then clears the cache.

methods.name: getTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves a specific tax class record from the database by ID.

methods.name: getTaxClasses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax class records with optional filtering and pagination, utilizing caching for performance.

methods.name: getTotalTaxClasses
methods.description: Returns the total count of tax class records in the database.

methods.name: addTaxRule
methods.description: Adds a new tax rule associated with a tax class into the database.

methods.name: deleteTaxRules
methods.description: Removes all tax rules linked to a specified tax class.

methods.name: getTaxRules
methods.description: Fetches all tax rules associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRulesByTaxRateId
methods.description: Counts the number of distinct tax classes associated with a specific tax rate.
